standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.npc: I can't belive Xilo hasn't shown up.

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.player: Were you expecting to meet someone here?

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.npc: My... friend, Xilo. I told her to meet me by the magic trees of the rainforest. We don't often have a chance to meet without a crowd of people around.

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.player: Why? Is she not particularly local to you?

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.npc: Unfortunately not. I'm from Aldarin, but she lives in Tal Teklan. It usually takes a special event being hosted for us both to be in the same place.

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.player: So you never really get any privacy?
Not at all. Sorry if it seemed like I was.

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.npc: It's okay... Sorry... I just miss her.

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.text: If the player has not already talked to Xilo:

steps.player: Do you think she's just running a little late?
Could she maybe have considered another tree magical?

steps.npc: I suppose she may be where we first met... but this is where we shared our first... you know...

steps.player: Well, I'll keep my fingers crossed for you. I'm sure you'll be able to find one another soon!

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.text: If the player has already talked to Xilo:

steps.player: Hang on... I think I might have met this Xilo.
By a tree to the north of here.

steps.npc: Oh, Xilo! She's gone to where we first met instead! Thank you, iknami. I'll head over there at once!

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.speaker: Xilo
standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.text: Hello again, iknami! Thank you for helping us find each other!

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.npc: To think we were waiting by different trees! It was so silly of us!

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.player: Well, I'm happy to see you together again. Now, I'm sure you have a lot of catching up to do. I'll leave you to it.
